scope: Verify that deleting a saved workspace profile in one open Editor tab removes the stale selection and all profile actions from another tab without retaining history that could restore the deleted profile.

finding.audit_gap: The workspace appearance suite covered profile creation becoming visible in another Editor tab, local profile deletion/undo/redo, and cross-tab workspace synchronization, but did not assert the deletion of a selected profile propagates to a peer tab.
finding.change: Extended the existing two-tab lifecycle test: select the profile in the receiving tab, delete it in the creating tab, and verify the peer drops the option, clears selection, disables load/export/delete, clears stale undo history, and announces the external change.

initial_targeted_attempt.failure: The new assertion attempted to reopen the appearance dialog although the existing cross-tab test intentionally kept it open; Playwright correctly reported that the modal intercepted the opener click.
